headline: Iran Says Tankers Struck Mines in Hormuz
deck: A maritime monitor said no authority had confirmed the reported incident.
body: Iran’s IRGC Navy said Monday night that three oil tankers had struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, reporting powerful explosions and fires aboard all three vessels; it said two were in the eastern part of the strait and one was near the southern coast. [E1][E2][E3]
On 20 November, this paper reported an Iranian army claim that three oil tankers had struck mines and caught fire in the eastern Strait of Hormuz. [E5]
Straits.live said the current claim was unverified and single-source, and that no maritime authority had confirmed either claim. [E4]
